en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a wide, straight, tree-lined avenue receding into the distance. Tall rows of trees form a canopy on both sides of the road. Several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing stand and walk along the avenue, including men in suits and hats and women in long dresses. At the bottom center there is a printed caption in French identifying the view as an area of Marseille called Le Prado, seen from the Rond-Point.
